description.value:
Three illusory copies of yourself spring up around you. For the duration, they move and act alongside you, shifting positions so no observer can tell which image is genuine; you can dismiss them as an action.

Whenever a creature attacks you while the duplicates remain, roll a d20 to see whether the attack is redirected to a duplicate instead: with three duplicates remaining you need a 6 or better, with two an 8 or better, and with one an 11 or better.

Each duplicate has an AC of 10 plus your Dexterity modifier and is destroyed the instant an attack hits it, ignoring all other damage or effects; the power ends once all three are destroyed. A creature that cannot see, that relies on senses other than sight such as blindsight, or that can identify illusions (such as with truesight) is unaffected.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 2
